name: paneliya-hrms-enterprise
description: Production-grade Enterprise Human Resource Management System (HRMS) built with Next.js and Nest.js

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
